alternatives.contract: Keep styleInputs in the expression and clear its supplied settings with styleInputs({}); temporary disconnect preserves inputs. Removing the helper itself is not an automatic clear.
alternatives.reason: Uses supported Lit APIs and preserves detached/cached component state; no runtime fork or private hook.
alternatives.cost: Authors clear inputs explicitly instead of relying on expression removal.

alternatives.contract: Retain exact automatic expression-removal cleanup and preservation on temporary disconnect.
alternatives.cost: Requires a supported disposal signal from Lit or a maintained dependency extension/fork; no such implementation is built or selected.

decisionRequired: Peter selects whether to revise this observable authoring contract.
actions: No production directive, private hook, runtime fork, or changed approved cleanup behavior added. Unrelated shared mechanisms remain verified.
proposedAlternativeVerification: Five additional explicit-clear checks per engine pass using the built ordered-state module in a scratch Lit directive. This verifies the proposal without installing a production directive or changing the approved contract.

attributeAlternative.directRetainedTargetRemoval: Attribute removal provides a separate signal, even while disconnected.
attributeAlternative.wholeTemplateDisposal: Old target keeps its marker and inputs, indistinguishable from a cached subtree.
attributeAlternative.preUpgradeLimit: A marker removed before definition has no later attributeChanged callback. A helper that waits for definition can also verify its marker before applying; the reduced fixture wrote early values and intentionally exposes that different path.
attributeAlternative.conclusion: Changing authoring position supports a narrower retained-element cleanup contract, but does not fulfill automatic cleanup for discarded containing templates. It needs an explicit scope/authoring revision as well.

preparedQuestion.subject: Clearing settings owned by the Lit style helper
preparedQuestion.context: The approved proposal asked removal of the helper to clear its styles while temporary disconnection preserves them. The installed and current upstream public Lit lifecycle cannot distinguish these cases. The failure reproduces in all three browser engines. Explicit empty-helper clearing passes representative checks.
preparedQuestion.recommendation: Keep styleInputs in the template and pass an empty object to clear its settings, preserving temporary disconnected/cached state.
options: Explicit clear: use styleInputs({}); this revises automatic expression-removal cleanup.
Keep exact automatic cleanup: retain the requirement and address the missing disposal signal through supported Lit extension/fork work before implementing the helper.
